description: This Java source file defines a service for providing data to an Android weather list widget, including a factory class for generating views for each weather item displayed in the widget.

classes.name: WeatherWidgetService
classes.description: A service that provides a factory to supply views for the weather widget collection.

classes.name: StackRemoteViewsFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing RemoteViewsFactory to generate views for each weather item in the widget.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the factory responsible for creating widget item views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup for the factory; empty as cursor is loaded in onDataSetChanged().

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up cursor resources when the factory is destroyed.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of weather data items based on cursor count.

methods.name: getViewAt
methods.description: Creates and returns a RemoteViews object for the weather item at the specified position, including setting up click intent.

methods.name: getLoadingView
methods.description: Returns null as no custom loading view is provided.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of different view types; here, two types are assumed.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for an item based on its position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that item IDs are stable.

methods.name: onDataSetChanged
methods.description: Refreshes the cursor data by querying the content resolver for updated weather info.
